test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Jaya asked if Riya was doing better than the previous day.

options.text: Jaya said to Riya, “Are you doing better than before?”
Jaya said to Riya, “If you are doing better than yesterday?”
Jaya said to Riya, “How are you doing today?”
Jaya said to Riya, “Are you doing better than yesterday?”

solution:
The correct answer is "**Jaya said to Riya, “Are you doing better than yesterday?**”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To convert the given sentence from **indirect speech to direct speech**, the following **rules **can be applied:

 
 
• Use **inverted commas** to indicate the **exact words spoken by the speaker**.
 
• Change the **reporting verb** and use a **suitable verb** that indicates the act of asking a question.
 
• Change the **tense **of the **reported speech** from **past tense** to **present tense**.
 
• Replace the **pronouns **with **suitable subject** and **object pronouns** based on the context.
 
 
 
• Using these rules, the correct option that expresses the given sentence in **direct speech** is:
 
 
• **Jaya asked, "Are you doing better than yesterday?"**
 
 

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.
